diagnose.name: heading-trailing-punctuation
diagnose.message: Heading ends with sentence punctuation. Headings usually read better without a trailing period, colon, or similar mark.

diagnose.name: heading-blank-lines
diagnose.message: Heading is directly attached to the following paragraph. Add a blank line after it.

diagnose.name: multiple-h1
diagnose.message: Document has more than one H1. Use H2 for subsections and keep one H1 for the page title.

fix.text:
# 本使用的來源貼上內容，轉換會在這台裝置上完成。
1. 使用 `⌘+C` 複製富文本內容
2. 在這個頁面使用 `⌘+V` 貼上
3. 編輯、預覽，然後複製 Markdown 結果
4. 按下 `Escape` 可以重設狀態
5. 使用 `Option+1` 與 `Option+2` 切換分頁
